name: Drills: wear and servicing
jem_summary: Stop the machine and use iron ingots on a worn drill. Stationary drills wear too.

pages.title: Wear
pages.text: Drills wear on moving contraptions and when stationary. Jade shows a stationary drill's current condition. At $(jemdrill:dull) wear, speed halves; at $(jemdrill:wear), the drill breaks. Bedrock destroys it immediately.

pages.title: Service
pages.text: Stop the contraption or stationary drill's rotation. Use iron ingots on the drill: one ingot per repaired drill. One interaction can service several worn drills on that contraption or kinetic network. Wear resets and the service count increases.

pages.title: Replacement
pages.text: A drill allows $(jemdrill:repairs) services. After that it can keep working until maximum wear but cannot be serviced again. Stop the machine and replace it before it breaks. Service does nothing while rotating, without wear or after the service allowance is exhausted.
